Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block [[Jokes#Alien speech and sounds|Alien speech and sounds]] ([[Wookiee Roar]] and [[MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid]]): a mouse droid rolls along a Death Star corridor towards Chewbacca and his two "guards", Luke Skywalker and Han Solo in stormtrooper armour, in ''Star Wars'' (1977), a moment before Chewbacca roars at it.

Source: a still from the film, posted with the article [https://starwarsaficionado.blogspot.com/2017/02/star-wars-at-40-when-mouse-met-wookiee.html 'Star Wars' at 40: When a 'Mouse' Met a Wookiee!], Star Wars Aficionado Website (22 February 2017); Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260511235810/https://starwarsaficionado.blogspot.com/2017/02/star-wars-at-40-when-mouse-met-wookiee.html Internet Archive], 11 May 2026.
